*
* Title: OEQMSTAT
* Author: J.L. Gibson
* Date Written: 14 June 1994
* Oracle Vers. Orig.: 7.0
* Revision History:
*
* Modified By Modified Date Version Description of changes
* ----------------------------------------------------------------
* J.L. Gibson 14 Jun 94 1.0 Initial version
* J.L. Gibson 21 Jun 94 2.0 Added exception
* handling and hint
* clean-up to fix AR#63573.
* Linh Tran 10 Mar 94 2.1 Added online help
*
* Abstract:
*
* This form allows the input of different criteria to execute
* the query. The order number and it's associated information
* is displayed depending on the critia of customer id, order type,
* order status, and from date/to date ranges.
*
* Modules Referenced:
* SRVLIB
*
* Inputs:
*
* Customer Identification - The id of valid customers
* Order Type - The different types of orders
* such as Regular, Custom,
* Transfer, Export, Emergency
* Order Status - The status of the order
* From Date - The start of a date range
* To Date - The end of a date range
*
* Outputs:
*
* Displaying the information for the user based on the criteria
* entered.
*
* Error Conditions:
*
* Validation checking on entered information and navigation
* checks for illegal keys entered.
*
* Assumptions and Limitations:
*
* Validation tables must be populated.
*
* Functional Descriptions:
*
* This form begins with entering either customer_id, order_type,
* order_status, or from_date and to_date. In addition, all of the
* fields can be entered or none of the fields. Upon completion of
* the control block, the query is executed and the order information
* is displayed.
*
****************************************************************************

Item.Name: S_CUSTOMER_ID
Item.Comment: This field is for customer identification
Item.Hint: Enter customer ID, use [LISTVAL], or leave blank for all customers.

Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText: :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_id VARCHAR2(10);
 ignore_payee VARCHAR2(2) := 'PA';
 include_cust VARCHAR2(2) := null;
 check_eff_date boolean := True;
begin
 if :s_customer_id is not null
 then
 select_customer(:s_customer_id, include_cust, ignore_payee,
 check_eff_date, temp_id);
 if temp_id is not null
 then
 :s_customer_id := temp_id;
 else
 return;
 end if;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 NEXT_ITEM;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 null;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 --
 
 if :s_customer_id is not null
 then
 select name into :s_name
 from customers
 where customer_id = :s_customer_id
 and customer_type != 'PA'
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- Invalid Customer ID
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTBLK
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 s_chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 :GLOBAL.field_left := :system.current_field;
 --Added on 05/08/2011; AV; IM: 5412
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate);
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 -- 
 go_query('Order_List');
 if :Order_list.order_no is null
 then
 show_error_dist('1716');
 /* MSG 1716 - Query caused no rows to be selected */
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 GO_ITEM(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 end if;
 if :insert_date is null
 then
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('INSERT_DATE',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'INSERT_DATE', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE );
 end if;
end;

Block.Name: ORDER_LIST
Block.WhereClause: where customer_id like nvl(:s_customer_id,'%') and order_type like nvl(:s_order_type,'%') and order_status like nvl(:s_order_status,'%') and trunc(insert_date) between nvl(:s_from_date, :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate -365) and nvl(:s_to_date, :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate) and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id
